title: P2 Licensed Plumber
description:
P2 Licensed Plumber

Join Connecticut's Premier Mechanical Services Team!

Our client is seeking a skilled and dependable P2 Licensed Plumber to join their growing team. You'll work alongside exceptional people in a supportive environment that rewards hard work, craftsmanship, and dedication. We are committed to helping our employees build long-term, rewarding careers while delivering outstanding service to our customers.

The ideal candidate will have experience in residential and/or commercial plumbing installations, service, and repairs while maintaining the highest standards of workmanship and customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair plumbing systems and fixtures

  • Diagnose plumbing issues and provide effective solutions

  • Perform service calls, maintenance, and emergency repairs

  • Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and specifications

  • Install water heaters, piping systems, fixtures, drains, and related equipment

  • Ensure all work complies with local and state plumbing codes

  • Maintain accurate service records and documentation

  • Communicate professionally with customers, coworkers, and management

  • Adhere to all safety policies and procedures

Qualifications

  • Valid Connecticut P2 Plumbing License required

  • Minimum 3 years of plumbing experience preferred

  • Experience with residential and/or commercial plumbing systems

  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills

  • Ability to work independently and manage workload effectively

  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

  • Strong work ethic and commitment to quality workmanship

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills

Compensation & Benefits

  • $70,000 - $150,000+ annual earning potential
  • Competitive hourly pay plus overtime opportunities
  • Year-round employment
  • Company vehicle
  • Health benefits
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Advancement opportunities within a growing organization

Additional Requirements

Applicants offered employment must successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening and background check.

If you're a licensed plumbing professional looking to join a company that values its employees and provides long-term career opportunities, we encourage you to apply today.

description:

We have a customer that specializes in electro-hydraulic controls and is hiring multiple Assemblers to add to their electronics and mechanical departments. This company is family owned and has been in business for over 50 years with 200+ employees here in Connecticut. On site, they do manufacturing, electronic assembly, PCB design and engineering.

title: Visual Quality Inspector
description:
Our client is a medical products manufacturer located in Oxford, CT, have been in business since 2007 and have been continuing to grow ever since! They manufacture package and sterilize foam pads, bandages, IV tubes among other medical products. The IV tubes are specially made so that they can be heated up by EMT's while rushing to save someone, and have a great success rate in saving people when they have huge losses of blood. With a team of over 30 employees, they are growing and seeking a Visual Quality Inspector to check the work of their packing department!

Why Work Here?
  • Paid employee lunches
  • Overtime Opportunity on weekdays and Saturday's if desired.
  • Opportunity for pay increase once permanent.
  • 2.5 PTO days already accrued once permanent and will continue to accrue as well as Birthdays are automatic additional PTO day.
  • 401K offered on first day after temp phase.

Responsibilities:
  • Checking the work of the packing team.
  • Packing team will be sending their packed products which include, gauze, bandages and other medical supplies into bags.
  • The Visual Quality Inspector will give the final stamp of approval on if the packed goods are sent to the shipping team or sent back to the packers to be repacked.
  • You will be checking for dirt, hair, dust etc anything that will make the medical products not sterile, will need to have good eyesight to recognize these discrepancies.
  • Will also need to know how to use Go-NoGo gauges, calipers, and micrometers.
Qualifications:
  • Experience with Micrometers and rulers.
  • Strong computer skills for digital paperwork.
  • Previous incoming inspection work is a plus!

1st Shift:
Mon - Fri
7:30 AM - 3:30 PM

Pay Rate:
$18.50-$19  to start and can earn raise once permanent.
